updates.note: Management indicates profitability will improve from Q3 levels and they will be in the ballpark of margins, with improvement in the midterm.
updates.quote: our profitability will improve from what we have in Q3 in spite of our investments.

updates.note: Management reported organic growth was negative under 1% for the quarter.
updates.quote: Organic growth is negative under 1% for the quarter.

new_promises.statement: Q4 FY26 will have the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
new_promises.quote: we believe that in the last quarter that is Q4, we will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil

new_promises.statement: The company will grow next year (FY27) higher than this year (FY26).
new_promises.quote: We will for sure grow next year higher than this year.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil
